name: Windsor.ai for Paid Media
description:
Windsor.ai for Paid Media connects your ad accounts so you can analyze performance and manage campaigns in plain language across Facebook Ads (Meta), Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft Ads (Bing), LinkedIn Ads, and Amazon Ads.

Ask questions and get answers from your connected accounts: compare spend, clicks, conversions, and ROAS across channels; find your best and worst campaigns; and break results down by campaign, ad set, or ad. Where the platform supports it, take action too: pause or enable a campaign, or set a budget, always after you confirm the change.

This is a focused, paid-media-only workspace. It connects only your advertising sources, so the tools stay on task for campaign analysis and management. Read access is available on the free plan with no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Windsor.ai for Paid Media to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Windsor.ai for Paid Media to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.windsor.ai/paid_media. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Windsor.ai for Paid Media MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for Paid Media lists 18 MCP tools, including contact_windsor, create_custom_field, create_destination_task, execute_action, get_connector_authorization_url, get_connector_connect_info, get_connectors, get_current_user, get_custom_fields, get_data, get_destination_setup_info, and get_destination_tasks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Windsor.ai for Paid Media?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Windsor.ai for Paid Media in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Windsor.ai for Paid Media MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for Paid Media requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Windsor.ai for Paid Media?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for Paid Media is developed by Windsor.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
